steps.subject: sky

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull the mountain shape

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: graze snow highlights with the knife

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: blend highlight upward, almost away
steps.rule: mountains should not look too distinct

steps.subject: far trees

steps.motion: tap from base upward, fade toward top
steps.rule: darker at the base where shadows sit, fading into the sky

steps.subject: trunk/limbs

steps.subject: snow

steps.rule: no green, since green in snow looks bad

steps.subject: snow

steps.action: dab thin snow highlights on the trees
steps.load: thin white and blue with a little liquid white
